name: future_only_classic
label: Do you now or in the future require visa sponsorship to work in the United States?
options: Yes, I will require sponsorship now
Yes, I will require sponsorship in the future
No, I do not and will not require sponsorship
expect: Yes, I will require sponsorship in the future
quote: When the question asks "now or in the future" and the options are split by time ... the answer is the option that says Yes for the FUTURE only. Never the "now" Yes option, never the No option.

quote: Option texts vary in wording and order; the option order must not matter.

No, I do not require sponsorship
